_comment: Copy of the settings. SETUP.bat copies this to config.json. Fill in the keys below. Never share config.json.
_assistant_name_help: Leave empty to use the default Arabic name.
_arabic_help: Set by the installer's Arabic check. If Arabic words show in reverse order on this laptop, set this to true.
_images_help: Optional. An OpenAI API key enables 'make me a picture of ...'.
_email_help: Gmail: smtp_username is the Gmail address that SENDS, smtp_app_password is a 16-letter App Password (Google Account > Security > 2-Step Verification > App passwords). send_to is where reports go.

safety._allow_all_commands_help: true = the helper may run ANY command (deleting, installing, registry...). Changes still ask Yes/No first. Keep false for Dad unless you need it.

_context_help: How much conversation the AI keeps in full, in tokens. 0 = the most the service allows (1 000 000 for Claude, 128 000 for DeepSeek). Long conversations are cached, so re-reading them costs about a tenth.
_memory_help: The helper remembers useful things from all conversations by itself (shown in the side panel).
_updates_help: At every start the helper checks this file on GitHub and installs newer versions by itself (settings are kept). Set enabled to false to stop that.
